scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm run init-env --prefix server && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: concurrently -k -s first -n db,init "npm run db:start --prefix server" "wait-on tcp:5433 && npm run db:push --prefix server && npm run db:setup --prefix server"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run db:start --prefix server" "wait-on tcp:5433 && npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
